headline: Sensex and Nifty Rebound as Crude Oil Dips; Axis Bank and Airtel Money in Focus

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Crude oil prices eased below $99 per barrel, providing a boost to market sentiment
Positive cues from Asian markets and Gift Nifty signaled a stronger start
Rebound in early trade led by gains in Kotak Mahindra and Bajaj Finance
Easing Middle East concerns and lower crude prices helped indices trade higher
whatHappening: Axis Bank has appointed former CEA Arvind Subramanian as an independent director for four years
Airtel Money, a mobile payments firm, announced plans for an IPO on the London Stock Exchange
IndiGo continues to dominate the domestic aviation sector with a 65% market share in August
Elecon Engineering shares surged 12% in trade, continuing a strong six-month upward trend
summary: Indian markets rebounded on September 23, with the Nifty trading above 23,400 as crude oil prices fell below $99 per barrel. Key corporate developments include Axis Bank's new board appointment and Airtel Money's London IPO plans. While banking and aviation sectors showed strength, Adani Group faced a legal setback regarding duty-free shop regulations.
